Why is the 101 Week kit offered at a dis: Why is the 101 Week kit offered at a discounted rate?
The Computer Science Student Association: The Computer Science Student Association heavily subsidizes the cost of each kit to ensure our events remain accessible to all students. For the $90 sale price, you receive over $90 worth of premium, limited-edition merch and admission to over $150 worth of unforgettable 101 Week events!
Do I have to go to every 101 Week event?: Do I have to go to every 101 Week event?
While we strongly encourage participatin: While we strongly encourage participating in as many activities as your schedule allows to maximize your orientation experience, there is no mandatory obligation to attend every event. We also incentivize participation by rewarding you with bottle caps for each event you attend, which can be traded in for exclusive prizes at the end of the week!

The possession of weapons, drugs, alcoho: The possession of weapons, drugs, alcohol, or any illegal substances is strictly prohibited at all 101 Week events. Additionally, select off-campus venues may enforce their own bag policies.
What resources are available for Indigen: What resources are available for Indigenous students during 101 Week?
All Indigenous students at uOttawa are r: All Indigenous students at uOttawa are represented by the Indigenous Students’ Association (ISA)! They have offered to cover the cost of your kit to alleviate any financial burden that buying the kit could cause (please note this is only available to First Nations, Metis, and Inuit students). Reach out to them via email at isa.uofo@gmail.com with the subject line “101 Week Kit Reimbursement” or send them a message on Instagram @isa.uottawa and they will reach out with more details!
